hypotheses.title: Batch 78: Orthogonal Domain Breakout (Sales Acceleration, PEAD SUE, & Volatility Term Structure)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Directly eliminates template recycling and shared factor crowding to maximize Uniqueness (targeting >= 0.85): (1) Top-Line Sales Acceleration & Revenue Yield (analyst4 / pv1) exploiting Post-Sales Announcement Drift in TOP2000 Subindustry Neutral. (2) Standardized Unexpected Earnings (SUE) Surprise Jump (analyst4) scaling quarterly EPS surprises by 1-year volatility in TOP1000 Industry Neutral. (3) Multi-Horizon Volatility Term Structure Contango Slope (option8) harvesting term premia between 3-year LEAP calls and 30-day options in TOPSP500 Sector Neutral.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if top-line revenue momentum or volatility term slopes degrade under sector/subindustry neutralization.

candidates.rationale: Candidate 1 (Post-Sales Announcement Drift Super Alpha): Longs equities exhibiting top-line sales acceleration over 1-year trailing baseline coupled with high annualized sales yield in TOP2000 Subindustry Neutral.
Candidate 2 (Standardized Unexpected Earnings SUE Jump Super Alpha): Combines quarterly EPS yield with 1-year standardized unexpected earnings surprise drift in TOP1000 Industry Neutral.

Candidate 3 (Volatility Term Structure Contango Slope Super Alpha): Captures institutional steep term-structure contango between 3-year LEAP call IV and 30-day IV paired with realized volatility slope in TOPSP500 Sector Neutral.
